title: I was insulted during by a tournament game
originalTitle: I was insulted during by a tournament game
transcript: It was my opponent's move, and he stood up from the table and just walked around and stood behind me on his move. Now, for those of you who don't know, in classical chess and in federated tournaments, you are not allowed to leave the board while it's your move. And this is uh for many reasons, but mainly, as far as I know, it's to prevent cheating. So, I was kind of shocked to see my opponent just stand up on on his move. And uh so, I whispered to him, uh I don't think you can leave the board while it's your move. And he kind of very very defensively and arrogantly said, Oh, yes, I can. Go talk to the arbiter. And I was like, okay, sure. So, I stood up. >> [laughter] >> I went to the arbiter, and I told her, Look, my opponent is standing up. It's his move. I asked him to sit down, and he's not. The arbiter comes with me. She checks the book of rules, and turns out, apparently, you can stand up during your move as long as you stay at the table and you stay at the board. What you're not allowed to do is wander off. So, okay, I said, oh, okay, that's fine. Thank you. And as the arbiter leaves, this guy, still standing up, tells me something along the along the lines of um you're making me waste time with your rules. And I was flabbergasted. I thought that was so uncalled for and so aggressive, and I had never ever ever seen anything like that in a tournament. And by the way, I forgot to mention, sometime amongst these moves, I also left the table while it was my opponent's move, and in in the meantime, my opponent had played a move. And when I sat down at the board, he started talking to me, which, by the way, again, like, it's not allowed. And he was like, why were you away from the board during your move? And again, like, I was just I was just shocked that that this guy was being this uh arrogant. And so, I said, "Well, I left while it was your move." He said, "Well, look at the clock." Like like a baby. Like I I I don't know. And I said, "Well, you pressed it while I was away." And after this, he looked at my shirt. I was wearing a an Assassin's Creed shirt. And he said, "You like Assassin's Creed?" And at that point, like I I I decided I'm not going to entertain this any longer. I want to play the game. So, I just shushed him. I went shh. And then I went back to focusing on the game. In this position, I play this move. I play king to c6. After he dragged on and played on until the very end. And after I play king to c6, this guy stops the clock and says, "Stalemate." And it's not It's not stalemate. The king can just go to c8. But, >> [laughter] >> he had this like very very cocky face claiming this stalemate. And uh like a after how rude he was, like I I wanted to kind of just laugh at him, but I didn't. Just like pointed out the square that he could move to and he signed.
